paragraphs: If your SLC300 is from the R172 generation, it uses the M274 petrol engine. This engine is part of the broader M270/M274 family, which is known for timing chain wear over time — a pattern well-documented across the C-Class and other Mercedes models of the same era. We replace the timing chain, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every M274 rebuild.
